title: The demo site died over the weekend (auto-shutdown and a dynamic IP)
intro: Monday 08:00: the customer demo at demo.contoso.com doesn't load. The VM vm-demo-02 (rg-demo) is running. Someone already restarted it. DNS for demo.contoso.com hasn't been touched in months.

steps.prompt: Resolve demo.contoso.com to see where DNS sends visitors.

expected_commands: az vm show --resource-group rg-demo --name vm-demo-02 -d --query publicIps
az vm show -g rg-demo -n vm-demo-02 -d --query publicIps
az vm list-ip-addresses --resource-group rg-demo --name vm-demo-02 --output table

steps.prompt: DNS points at the old IP. Find out why it changed: look at vm-demo-02's operations in the Activity Log for the last 3 days (rg-demo).
expected_commands: az monitor activity-log list --resource-group rg-demo --offset 72h --output table
az monitor activity-log list -g rg-demo --offset 72h -o table
az monitor activity-log list --resource-group rg-demo --offset 3d --output table
steps.hint: Look for deallocate and start operations.

steps.prompt: An auto-shutdown schedule deallocated the VM on Friday at 19:00. Deallocation released the dynamic public IP, and the restart got a new one. Check the SKU and allocation method of its IP resource pip-demo-02.
expected_commands: az network public-ip show --resource-group rg-demo --name pip-demo-02 --query "{sku:sku.name, allocation:publicIPAllocationMethod}"
az network public-ip show -g rg-demo -n pip-demo-02

steps.prompt: Make the IP static so it survives deallocation: update pip-demo-02's allocation method to Static.
expected_commands: az network public-ip update --resource-group rg-demo --name pip-demo-02 --allocation-method Static
az network public-ip update -g rg-demo -n pip-demo-02 --allocation-method Static
steps.hint: --allocation-method Static keeps the current address from now on.

resolution: Deallocating a VM stops compute billing (see azure-tutorial-003), but a Basic-SKU dynamic public IP is released with it, and the VM gets a new address when it starts again. The DevTest Labs auto-shutdown schedule deallocated vm-demo-02 on Friday evening, so Monday's restart came up on a new IP while DNS still pointed at the old one, which may even belong to another customer by now. The fix has two parts: make the IP Static (it's now kept across deallocations), then update the DNS A record to 20.73.52.203. Better still, give the demo an Azure-provided DNS label on the public IP, or put it behind a load balancer or Front Door with a stable address. Note that Basic-SKU public IPs are being retired in favour of Standard, which is always static.
